Out of **4,269** active remote opportunities, **939** (the **22%** share) state any compensation figure, leaving **3,330** listings (**78%**) silent on pay. Most candidates must negotiate without a baseline because 78% of active listings do not state a pay figure. ## Which high‑paying roles are visible in the data? Two listings in our sample reveal the top‑end of the USD scale: | Company | Role | Stated Pay (USD) | Listing Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | OpenAI | Data Scientist, Core Experimentation | **293,000–325,000** per yearly | active until 2026‑08‑07 | | Equinix, Inc. | Chief of Staff (Global Energy & Real Estate) | **195,000–319,000** per yearly | active until 2026‑05‑26 | | Autodesk | Database Architect | *pay not disclosed* | active until 2026‑05‑26 | | Apify | Senior Product Marketing Manager | *pay not disclosed* | active until 2026‑08‑09 | | Binance | UI/UX Design (Accelerator Program) | *pay not disclosed* | active until 2026‑08‑12 | ## How dominant is AI as a required skill in remote USD jobs? Our skill‑demand snapshot (4,282 listings) shows **517** positions (**12%**) list AI expertise as a requirement. AI expertise is required in 12% of listings. OpenAI is hiring for 200 new jobs in Dublin. ## Are worldwide‑open positions the majority of the market? Yes. **2,725** of the **4,269** active listings (**64%**) welcome applicants from any country. 64% of active listings are open to applicants from any country. ## Skill demand snapshot: communication vs. AI Beyond AI, the most requested soft skill is communication, appearing in **1,662** listings (**39%**). Leadership, sales, project management, and data analysis round out the top six, each representing between **7%** and **10%** of the demand. ## How to target the transparent‑pay listings? 1. **Filter** for “USD salary disclosed” on the Loker Dollar board. 2. **Prioritize** roles that list AI or communication as a key skill—these match the highest‑pay brackets. 3. **Check freshness:** **1,205** listings were posted in the last 7 days, indicating a fast‑moving market. 4. **Tailor your application** to the specific skill set (e.g., showcase AI projects or clear technical documentation). ## Methodology - **Source:** Loker Dollar remote‑job listings (D1 jobs table). - **Query date:** 2026‑10‑13. - **Sample sizes:** Active listings = 4,269; distinct companies = 1,496; skill‑demand snapshot = 4,282. - **Limitations:** Pay figures are only available for listings that voluntarily disclose them (**22%** of total). Skill tags are based on employer‑provided keywords, which may omit implicit requirements. ## What we don’t know - Internal equity structures, bonus schemes, or stock options for the silent‑pay listings. - - ## FAQ ### Which remote jobs actually list USD compensation? Only the **22%** of active listings (939 out of 4,269) provide a salary figure. Use the “USD salary disclosed” filter to isolate them. ### Is the market truly global, or are there hidden location constraints? **64%** of listings (2,725) are marked as open to worldwide applicants, but each posting still specifies core working‑hour expectations that may favor certain time zones. ### Do AI skills guarantee a higher salary? AI appears in **12%** of listings, and the two disclosed high‑pay roles (OpenAI and Equinix) are both technically intensive.
